context.body: Antioch and the first mission · Acts 13:13–43
context.label: Antioch and the first mission

observations.body: Paul speaks through Israel’s story in Antioch. Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem. Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

payload.posture: Read Acts 13:13–43 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul speaks through Israel’s story in Antioch. Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem. Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
